sections.title: Morning Shift (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at the office. Debriefing with night shift.
Gearing up then heading on patrols.
Heading out on patrol towards Aotea Square. We will conduct welfare checks on businesses.
Starbucks, Queen St McDonald's all clear. Continuing towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Commencing a sweep of the area.
Library area all clear. Heading towards Victoria St via Wellesley and Federal St.

Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Federal St. Wellesley and Federal St all clear with welfare checks completed from Eighty Fed, Coffee Club, and both 77 Convenience Stores. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Wyndham St via Federal St.
Standing by at the corner of Wyndham and Albert St. Welfare check on Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Wyndham St all clear. Chemist Warehouse just opening. Standing by for security presence.
Vulcan Lane all clear. Heading towards Chancery Square via Freyburg Square.
Freyburg, O'Connell St and Chancery Square all clear, standing by for security presence.
Arrived at the fountain area on Lorne St after patrolling up Kitchener St. Heading towards High St via Lorne St.
Lorne St and High St all clear. Heading towards Fort St.
Fort St, Pocket Park, Fort Lane, Wilson Carpark, Right Track, Jo&Joes, Coffee Club and 77 Convenience Store all clear. Heading towards Gore St for a full sweep of the area.
Gore St all clear. This includes Auckland Harbour Suites, Smiley Mart, Chargrill, and SO/.
Britomart McDonald's welfare checks completed, no issues to report. Commercial Bay all clear. Standing by for the security presence.
Albert Mart all clear. Heading down Swanson St to Queen St New Worlds.
Arrived at New World Queen St. No issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Queen St McDonald's about a vagrant outside their store. Heading to assist.
Arrived at Queen St McDonald's and the POI has already left. Standing by for security presence.
Commencing welfare checks on surrounding businesses.

Timezone, Bhan Mi, Mid City, Unichem, 77 Convenience Store, The Sales Shop, Footlocker, Bag Planet, Ippondo, Localito, Cotton On, Nike and Starbucks all clear. No issues to report. Heading up Victoria to check in on Woolworths.
Woolworths Victoria St and Chemist Warehouse all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on Elliot St and Darby St.
Darby and Elliot St all clear. No issues from Celine or Lumi Cafe. Heading down Queen St to do welfare checks on businesses.
Welfare checks on Mecca and Farmers down till OPSM and Hallensteins all clear. Checking in on Chemist Warehouse.
All clear at Chemist Warehouse. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare checks from Kathmandu and JB-Hifi down to Q Convenience all clear. Checking in at Britomart McDonald's.
Britomart McDonald's all clear. Standing by for security presence.
All clear, standing by for security presence.
Received a call about a female vagrant smoking weed outside Cotton On. Heading to location to assist.
Vagrant had left before we arrived. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to office to have break.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Arrived at Headquarters, handover completed with morning shift, equipment checked, standing by charging ops phone due to low battery percentage.
Ops phone is at a sufficient battery percentage, commencing patrols from Headquarters onto Queen Street starting with the upper Queen Street areas.
Welfare check completed on Nike, Cotton On, Localito, Footlocker. All clear, checked up on staff. No issues to report.
Welfare check completed on Unichem, Queen Street McDonald's. All clear, checked up on staff, no issues to report.
Full sweep on Darby Street. All clear, no issues to report. Welfare check completed on Recycle Boutique, all clear, no issues to report.

Full sweep on Elliot St, all clear, no issues to report. Welfare check completed on Elliot Stables, checked up on staff, no issues to report. Making our way over to Aotea Square via Wellesley St West and Albert Street.
Sweep Wellesley Street West, all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Albert Street, all clear, no issues to report.
We've arrived at Aotea Square, now commencing full sweep.
Full sweep of Aotea Square, standing by due to heavy foot traffic in the area.
Crossing over from Aotea Square to Lorne Street for a full sweep.
Full sweep Lorne Street completed. Heading over to High Street via Victoria St East. Upper Queen areas completed, commencing patrols for lower Queen areas.
Welfare check completed on Looksharp Victoria Street.
Welfare check completed on Two Dollar Things High Street.
Welfare check completed on Tattys Designer High Street.
Full sweep on Chancery Square, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep Vulcan Lane completed, no issues to report.
Full sweep Fort St, Fort Ln completed, welfare check completed on Jo&Joes, checked up on staff, no issues to report.
Sweep Custom Street East, Custom Street West and convenience store on Customs Street. All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived Commercial Bay, commencing a full sweep.
Full sweep Commercial Bay, welfare check completed on Britomart McDonald's, checked up on staff, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining presence.
We received a response call from Elliot Stables staff requesting assistance to remove someone from their premises. Heading over there now.
Full sweep Darby Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Arrived Elliott Stables, the POI had already left before we arrived. Standing by maintaining presence.

We heard people yelling on Queen Street near Queen St McDonald's; we approached them and told them to keep it down and split the group. Standing by on Queen St / Victoria St West maintaining presence.
Welfare check completed on Queen Street McDonald's. Checked up on the staff. No issues to report. Standing by maintaining presence due to multiple vagrants in area loitering.
Heading over to Commercial Bay for a full sweep.
Arrived Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Commercial Bay completed. Welfare check completed on Britomart McDonald's, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining presence due to heavy foot traffic mainly outside the McDonald's.
Heading back to Headquarters for floor checks.
Floor checks completed, starting our scheduled break.
Afternoon shift completed. Equipment checked and returned. Handover to Nightshift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:55 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

Received a call from Queen Street McDonald's regarding a male vagrant harassing customers for money. Staff attempted to intervene but was met with hostility. Responding to assist in removal of vagrant.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. Male was outside the store and asked us for money, to which we advised him not to re-enter the restaurant to avoid any further issues. Male was compliant and was last seen moving down Queen Street towards Victoria Street West.
Check in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues to report.
Check in Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Check in Britomart Maccas, no issues to report.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep Quay St, all clear, no issues.
Check in Provedor + AAS, no issues to report.
Check in Danny Doolans, standby showing security presence.
Danny Doolans, no issues to report.
Welfare check marina guards, no issues to report.
Check in Albert St Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Check in 77 Convenience Store, no issues.

Responded to call from Queen St Maccas due to individual sleeping inside premises; asked him to move along, he resisted for a while. At 01:35 he complied and was last seen walking down Queen St heading towards Victoria St.
Full sweep Elliot St / Wilson Carpark / Darby St, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ due to rain and phone is low, going to charge ops phone.
On standby at HQ charging ops phone.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener St, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wilson Carpark / Fort St, all clear, no issues.
Check in Gore St, all clear, no issues.
Check in Aotea Gifts Shop, no issues.
Check in 77 Convenience Store, no issues.
Full sweep Victoria St, all clear, no issues.
Check in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, all clear, no issues to report.
Check in Aotea Square, all clear, no issues to report.
Check in Queen St Maccas, no issues. Heading back to HQ for 30 minutes break.
